description_en: Modifies the effective status of masking rules
description_zh: 调用DsgDesensPlanUpdateStatus接口，修改脱敏规则的生效状态
name: DsgDesensPlanUpdateStatus

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the masking rules whose status you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改状态的脱敏规则ID集合
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en:
The code of the level-1 masking scenario to which the masking rule belongs. Valid values:
dataworks_display_desense_code: Data Studio and Data Map display masking.
maxcompute_desense_code: MaxCompute engine layer masking.
maxcompute_new_desense_code: MaxCompute engine layer masking (new).
hologres_display_desense_code: Hologres engine layer masking.
dataworks_data_integration_desense_code: Data Integration static data masking.
dataworks_analysis_desense_code: Data Analysis display masking
parameters.help_zh:
脱敏规则所属的一级脱敏场景Code。取值如下：
数据开发/数据地图展示脱敏：dataworks_display_desense_code
MaxCompute引擎层脱敏：maxcompute_desense_code
MaxCompute引擎层脱敏（新）：maxcompute_new_desense_code
Hologres引擎层脱敏：hologres_display_desense_code
数据集成静态脱敏：dataworks_data_integration_desense_code
数据分析展示脱敏：dataworks_analysis_desense_code
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en:
The effective status of the masking rule. Valid values:
0: Inactive.
1: Active
parameters.help_zh:
脱敏规则的生效状态。取值如下：
0：失效。
1：生效
parameters.name: status

Data.description_en:
The operation result. Valid values:
true: The operation succeeded.
false: The operation failed
Data.description_zh:
操作结果。取值如下：
true：操作成功。
false：操作失败

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call succeeded.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
